# All sloppyCAN signals

<p class="lead">Every signal the car, the truck and the tractor exchange with sloppyCAN. In: sent by
sloppyCAN to the simulator. Out: sent by the simulator.</p>

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_guide_signals.mjs from contract/carlito_contract.json (version 68): edit the contract, then rerun it. -->

| Signal | Direction | Unit | Vehicles | What it is | More |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accel` | in | % | car, truck, tractor | Accelerator pedal. | [The engine](engine.md) |
| `brake` | in | % | car, truck, tractor | Foot brake. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `steer` | in | % | car, truck, tractor | Steering, negative = left. | [Steering and Ackermann](steering.md) |
| `handbrake` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Parking brake: the rear wheels' own hardware, a mechanical hold no ABS modulates. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `key` | in | enum | car, truck, tractor | Ignition key position. | [The engine](engine.md) |
| `lights` | in | enum | car, truck, tractor | Headlight state. | [Wind and conditions](conditions.md) |
| `gear` | in | enum | car, truck, tractor | RAMN gear byte. | [Gearbox and shifting](gearbox.md) |
| `turnL` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Left turn signal. | [Controls and who drives](controls.md) |
| `turnR` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Right turn signal. | [Controls and who drives](controls.md) |
| `horn` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Horn button; honk on rising edge. | [Controls and who drives](controls.md) |
| `checkEngine` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Check-engine warning LED. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `battery` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Battery warning LED. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `brakeLamp` | in | flag | car, truck, tractor | Rear stop-lamp state, from the RAMN 0x1BB brake bit. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `tcs_off` | in | flag | car | Traction control off request. | [Slip and the grip curve](slip.md) |
| `esc_off` | in | flag | car, truck | Electronic stability control off request. | [Understeer and oversteer](understeer.md) |
| `speed` | out | m/s | car, truck, tractor | Signed longitudinal speed. | [Air and rolling resistance](resistance.md) |
| `kmh` | out | km/h | car, truck, tractor | Absolute speed for the speedometer. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `rpm` | out | rev/min | car, truck, tractor | Engine RPM. | [The engine](engine.md) |
| `gear` | out | enum | car, truck, tractor | Currently engaged gear: P only where a park pawl is fitted, N where a P request found none. | [Gearbox and shifting](gearbox.md) |
| `gear_top` | out | count | car, truck, tractor | The tallest drive byte this vehicle's gearbox selects: a stepped box's ratio count, a CVT's range count. | [Gearbox and shifting](gearbox.md) |
| `throttle` | out | % | car, truck, tractor | The arbitrated pedal, not the fuel the engine receives: where fitted, the governor, limiter and shift cut act after it, and the delivered fuel shows in engine_load / fuel_rate. | [Air and rolling resistance](resistance.md) |
| `yaw` | out | rad/s | car, truck, tractor | Yaw rate. | [Steering and Ackermann](steering.md) |
| `accLong` | out | m/s^2 | car, truck, tractor | Longitudinal acceleration. | [Forces on a vehicle](forces.md) |
| `accLat` | out | m/s^2 | car, truck, tractor | Lateral acceleration. | [Forces on a vehicle](forces.md) |
| `steer` | out | % | car, truck, tractor | Steering as applied by the sim. | [Steering and Ackermann](steering.md) |
| `slip` | out | ratio | car, truck, tractor | Tire slip PER AXLE, each wheel's slip read as one size: its longitudinal slip ratio and its side slip together, the pair the tyre model reads, averaged over the axle. | [Slip and the grip curve](slip.md) |
| `ground` | out | flag | car, truck, tractor | Wheels on ground. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `posX` | out | m | car, truck, tractor | World X position. |  |
| `posZ` | out | m | car, truck, tractor | World Z position. |  |
| `heading` | out | deg | car, truck, tractor | Compass heading. | [Steering and Ackermann](steering.md) |
| `lat` | out | deg | car, truck, tractor | GPS latitude; world XZ mapped around the Paris origin. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `lon` | out | deg | car, truck, tractor | GPS longitude. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `odo` | out | km | car, truck, tractor | Odometer. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `status` | out | bitfield | car, truck, tractor | Status bitfield. | [Weight transfer and rollover](weight-transfer.md) |
| `impact` | out | m/s^2 | car, truck, tractor | Impact event magnitude. | [Position, heading and distance](position.md) |
| `fuel` | out | % | car, truck, tractor | Fuel level. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `coolant` | out | degC | car, truck, tractor | Coolant temperature. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `brake_temp` | out | degC | car, truck, tractor | Brake temperature: the HOTTEST friction brake on the powered unit. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `battery` | out | V | car, truck, tractor | Battery/pack terminal voltage. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `speed_limit` | out | km/h | car, truck, tractor | Road-speed governor: the maximum road speed this vehicle is allowed to make, 0 = ungoverned. | [The engine](engine.md) |
| `hitch_pos` | in | % | tractor | Requested rear hitch position. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `pto` | in | flag | truck, tractor | PTO engage request. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `hitch_pos_actual` | out | % | tractor | Actual hitch position. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `pto_state` | out | flag | truck, tractor | PTO engaged. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `pto_rpm` | out | rev/min | tractor | PTO shaft speed = engine rpm x the gearing of the selected pto_mode, 0 when disengaged. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `engine_load` | out | % | truck, tractor | Engine load: the torque the engine is delivering as a fraction of a reference torque, taken here as the PEAK of the torque curve. | [Ground and tyre types](surfaces.md) |
| `implement_connected` | out | flag | tractor | An implement has claimed an address on the implement bus. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `implement_type` | out | enum | tractor | Attached implement's ISO 11783-1 device class, reported with the address claim. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `diff_lock` | in | flag | tractor | Rear differential lock request. | [Differentials and four-wheel drive](differentials.md) |
| `fwd_drive` | in | flag | tractor | MFWD front-axle engage request. | [Differentials and four-wheel drive](differentials.md) |
| `pto_mode` | in | enum | tractor | PTO speed selection. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `hand_throttle` | in | % | tractor | Hand throttle position. | [The engine](engine.md) |
| `diff_lock_state` | out | flag | tractor | Rear differential actually locked, read out of the driveline. | [Differentials and four-wheel drive](differentials.md) |
| `fwd_drive_state` | out | flag | tractor | Front axle actually driven, read out of the driveline. | [Differentials and four-wheel drive](differentials.md) |
| `wheel_speed` | out | km/h | tractor | ISO wheel-based speed: the driveline's own speed, from the mean spin of the rear axle through the tire radius. | [Slip and the grip curve](slip.md) |
| `ground_speed` | out | km/h | tractor | ISO ground-based speed: the chassis' own forward velocity, independent of the wheels. | [Slip and the grip curve](slip.md) |
| `wheel_slip` | out | % | tractor | Wheel slip: how far wheel_speed runs ahead of ground_speed, as a percentage of wheel_speed. | [Slip and the grip curve](slip.md) |
| `engine_hours` | out | h | truck, tractor | Hour meter: engine running time, accumulated while the key is at Ignition. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `draft_force` | out | % | tractor | Draft: the rearward pull of an implement working IN the soil, as a percentage of the tractor's rated draft. | [Forces on a vehicle](forces.md) |
| `guidance_curvature` | in | 1/km | tractor | Guidance curvature command: the reciprocal of the turn radius the guidance system wants the tractor to drive, negative = curving left. | [Steering and Ackermann](steering.md) |
| `scv_flow` | in | % | tractor | Selective control valve flow command: how far the tractor's hydraulic remote is opened, 0 = closed. | [Implements and the PTO](implements.md) |
| `twd` | out | deg | car, truck, tractor | True wind direction: the compass bearing the wind comes FROM, which is what every marine and weather instrument reads. | [Wind and conditions](conditions.md) |
| `tws` | out | m/s | car, truck, tractor | True wind speed, read straight out of the level's WindField - measured, not modeled. | [Wind and conditions](conditions.md) |
| `fuel_rate` | out | L/h | car, truck, tractor | Fuel consumption rate, a LABELLED HONEST MODEL read out of the sim: the delivered fuel Drivetrain.applied_throttle adds fuel x to the crank over its motoring torque, and that torque's power over a sourced indicated efficiency per fuel is the burn, so a fuel cut burns nothing, idle burns the friction power, and part load costs more per kWh. | [Air and rolling resistance](resistance.md) |
| `retarder` | in | % | truck | Auxiliary driveline retarder request, 0 = released. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `red_stop` | in | flag | truck | Red Stop Lamp from the J1939-73 DM1 lamp status byte: an active fault severe enough to stop the vehicle. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `amber_warn` | in | flag | truck | Amber Warning Lamp from the J1939-73 DM1 lamp status byte: a fault that needs attention but does not stop the vehicle. | [Fuel, coolant, battery and air](auxiliary.md) |
| `protect_lamp` | in | flag | truck | Protect Lamp from the J1939-73 DM1 lamp status byte: the NON-electronic fault — a fluid level, pressure or temperature out of range. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `air_primary` | out | bar | truck | Service brake air pressure, circuit 1. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `air_secondary` | out | bar | truck | Service brake air pressure, circuit 2. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `retarder_state` | out | % | truck | Retarder torque as actually applied to the driven axle, read out of the driveline rather than echoed from the request: the speed fade and the anti-lock traction cap have already happened. | [Brakes](brakes.md) |
| `gear_ratio` | out | ratio | truck, tractor | Actual gear ratio: the gearbox's input speed over its output, final drive excluded, unsigned. | [Gearbox and shifting](gearbox.md) |
| `axle_load` | out | kg | truck, tractor | Drive-axle load. | [Forces on a vehicle](forces.md) |
| `body_cmd` | in | enum | truck | Refuse body command on the BODY network — CiA 422 'CleANopen', the CANopen application profile for municipal vehicles, standardized as EN 16815:2019. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `body_state` | out | enum | truck | Refuse body state as reported by the body's CiA 422 functional unit and translated to the chassis by the gateway. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `body_pos` | out | % | truck | Arm travel, 0 = stowed, 100 = fully raised up and back over the cab. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `body_inhibit` | out | flag | truck | The body interlock, and the one value in this contract that visibly crosses a bus boundary: it is computed on the CHASSIS side — road speed above walking pace, the chassis PTO not engaged, or the parking brake released — and published on the BODY network by the gateway. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `body_bus` | out | flag | truck | Body network powered and the gateway answering. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `hopper_load` | out | % | truck | Hopper fill. | [The trucks](truck.md) |
| `trailer_ebs_fault` | in | flag | truck | Trailer EBS fault reported over the trailer bus — the towed unit's counterpart of the chassis DM1 lamps, and the only 'in' signal this bus has. | [Towing](towing.md) |
| `trailer_connected` | out | flag | truck | A trailer has claimed on the ISO 11992 bus: the ISO 7638 connector is coupled AND the towing unit carries the data pair on pins 6 and 7. | [Towing](towing.md) |
| `trailer_axle_load` | out | kg | truck | Towed-unit axle load. | [Suspension](suspension.md) |
| `trailer_brake_demand` | out | % | truck | The braking demand the towing unit SENDS to the trailer. | [Towing](towing.md) |
| `trailer_brake_applied` | out | % | truck | The service brake level the trailer has actually reached, towed-to-towing. | [Towing](towing.md) |
| `trailer_abs` | out | flag | truck | Trailer ABS active. | [ABS, traction and stability control](driver-aids.md) |
| `trailer_vdc` | out | flag | truck | Trailer VDC active. | [ABS, traction and stability control](driver-aids.md) |
| `trailer_abs_lamp` | in | flag | truck | Trailer ABS telltale over SAE J2497 / PLC4TRUCKS — the ENTIRE North American truck/trailer protocol, in one bit. | [Towing](towing.md) |
